when: admin has no grant
expect: GET recording -> 403; explicit self-grant then -> 200

when: A has dirty progress and download; switch to B during request
expect: A response never commits into B; A pending write never authenticates as B

when: same session/token/requestId sent again within 60s
expect: same token pair, deadlines unchanged; after expiry -> 401 refresh_retry_expired

when: old token reused with different requestId
expect: 401 refresh_reuse; revoke that device only

when: identical operationId/body after successful write
expect: original status/body; no additional revision

when: same operationId, different body
expect: 409 operation_id_reused; no update

when: current revision 1; write baseRevision 0
expect: 409 position_conflict, durable candidate and conflictId; unchanged current position

when: new layout; valid old file/version anchor
expect: 412 layout_changed; preserve original candidate; refetch and submit new operation against current layout

when: same file ID, different content version
expect: 412 content_changed; no offset mapping to new bytes; retain old offline snapshot

when: server revision advanced after user saw choices
expect: 409 preserve unresolved candidate; ask again

when: last file really reaches playback end
expect: finish recording once; one history event for transition; no alternative recording completion

when: seek to end without playback end event
expect: position may change; completion unchanged

when: online check confirms grant removed
expect: 403 library_access_denied; stop affected operations, lock cache, preserve data

when: authorization cannot be checked due to network failure
expect: keep authorized old snapshot playable offline; do not infer revocation

when: logout during in-flight download
expect: lock scope immediately; old request cannot publish into new scope

when: source contains negative/duplicate/descending/out-of-file start
expect: reject whole source with issue; keep evidence/edits; try next source

when: missing input or unknown file timing
expect: explicit incomplete; no whole-recording play/download; no fabricated zero duration

when: cookie request changes state without valid CSRF or allowed Origin
expect: 403 csrf_failed; no mutation

when: third-party client supplies valid bearer and grant
expect: same permitted operations; no official-app attestation

when: manual/offline completion has stale completion revision
expect: 409 completion_conflict, preserve attempted event; no hidden overwrite
